LanguageData.ColonySummary_HeaderOrientationTip: How the skill names above each column are drawn.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_HeaderInclinedTip: Tilts the headers so narrow columns stay readable.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_HeaderVerticalTip: Turns the headers on their side, for the narrowest columns.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_HeaderStackedTip: Stacks the first letters of each header top to bottom. Suits languages with fixed-width characters, such as Chinese.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_HeaderHorizontalTip: Draws the headers as the vanilla Work tab does, every other one lower.
